eyebrow: Transformations — build the plan, run nothing
code:
.filter() / .where()   -- keep matching rows
.select()               -- keep certain columns
.withColumn()           -- add or replace a column
.groupBy()              -- group rows for aggregation
.join()                 -- combine two DataFrames
caption: Every one returns a NEW DataFrame you can keep chaining onto — and runs nothing, per Lesson 34.

code:
.show()             -- prints rows
.count()             -- returns a plain number
.collect()           -- returns all rows to the Driver
.write.parquet(...)  -- writes the result to storage
.take(n)             -- returns the first n rows
caption: Every one runs the WHOLE plan that led up to it, all at once.

code:
result = (
  df.filter(df["fare_amount"] > 0)
    .withColumn("fare_per_mile", df["fare_amount"] / df["trip_distance"])
    .groupBy("VendorID")
    .avg("fare_per_mile")
)
# Still nothing has run.

result.show()   # NOW all four run together, one optimized pass
caption: Because nothing ran individually, Spark combines all four steps into one efficient pass.
